messages:
Diego: Starting a thread for AuroraBank POC. They require: no public egress, preserved client source IPs in logs, and SNI inspection by their inline IDS. Need recommended connectivity pattern + minimal port list + pricing delta between Hosted vs Private.

Anya: Quick answer: to preserve source IPs you must run the data plane inside their VPC (Private deployment), or terminate TLS in their infra and forward X-Forwarded-For to our endpoint. PrivateLink from our side typically NATs.

CloudOps: Topology options to propose:
- Private deployment (recommended): workers deploy into customer VPC subnets, no internet egress, client IP preserved.
- PrivateLink + customer TLS terminate: interface endpoint in customer VPC, NLB in passthrough mode to keep SNI visible.
- VPC peering: for single-account POCs only; simpler but not multi-account friendly.

Diego: They want a one-paragraph statement for procurement: "Can Redwood support on-prem/TGW/PrivateLink and preserve client IPs for audit?"

Anya: Paste this: "Redwood supports private deployments where runtime workers run in the customer's VPC to meet source-IP preservation and no-internet-egress requirements. When using PrivateLink or provider-hosted workers, customers must terminate TLS in their network or configure a proxy that forwards client IP via X-Forwarded-For."

SalesEng: Pricing note: Private deploy adds a setup/onboarding fee + reserved-minimum capacity for the POC. If traffic never leaves customer network (no public egress) we can discount egress line items. I'll draft numbers.

CloudOps: Minimal firewall checklist for their NetSec (pasteable):
- Allow outbound TCP 443 from customer worker subnets to Redwood control-plane CIDRs
- Allow inbound TCP 443 to worker ENIs (if private deploy)
- For PrivateLink: create interface endpoints; SG must allow TCP 443
- NAT/ephemeral ports: ensure NACLs permit ephemeral outbound 1024-65535 for responses.

Diego: Any concrete CIDRs we can give now?

InfraBot: Created ticket NET-4682 for CIDR disclosure — owners CloudOps. Due 48h.

Anya: I'll draft the one-page runbook (topology diagram, SG snippets, test commands like curl with --resolve and tcpdump instructions) and post here within 12h.

SalesEng: Scheduling a 30m call with AuroraBank NetSec 10:00 PT to review. I'll attach the SOC excerpt and preliminary quote.

Diego: thanks team :thumbsup:
